releases.notes:
First release — see any player's statistics on Fabric servers.

**Pick the jar matching your Minecraft version:** 1.21.11 · 26.1.x · 26.2

- Works with 100% vanilla clients via chat: `/stats view <player>`, `/stats get`, `/stats top <stat>` leaderboards, `/stats topin <type> <stat>`
- With the mod on the client too: a **Player Stats…** button on the vanilla Statistics screen — browse any player (online or offline) by category
- `/stats hide` / `/stats show` privacy opt-out
- Fully configurable: command aliases, permissions, leaderboard size, offline players, cooldowns, highlight stats, button position
- Any mix of modded/vanilla client & server stays fully playable

Requires Fabric API. Install server-side for commands; client-side is optional.
